name: Thornwood Village
description: A small village at the edge of the wilderness, home to farmers, craftsmen, and a cozy tavern

town.square.name: Village Square
town.square.description: The heart of Thornwood Village. A weathered stone fountain stands in the center, surrounded by simple wooden buildings. The Rusty Cauldron tavern sits to the east, an apothecary shop to the north, a healer's cottage to the south, and the town hall to the west.

town.tavern.name: The Rusty Cauldron
town.tavern.description: A warm and inviting tavern with a crackling fireplace. The tavern keeper, a stout woman named Maggie, wipes down the bar while eyeing you with curiosity. A trapdoor in the corner leads down to the cellar, and scratching sounds can be heard from below.

village.apothecary_shop.name: Aldric's Apothecary
village.apothecary_shop.description: A cluttered shop filled with dried herbs, bubbling alembics, and shelves of colorful potions. Master Aldric, a thin man with spectacles and ink-stained fingers, works at a worn wooden counter. The air smells of lavender and sulfur.

village.healers_cottage.name: Healer's Cottage
village.healers_cottage.description: A cozy cottage with whitewashed walls and bundles of medicinal herbs hanging from the rafters. Healer Gwendolyn, a kind-faced woman in simple robes, tends to a small garden of healing plants by the window. A cot in the corner awaits patients.

village.town_hall.name: Thornwood Town Hall
village.town_hall.description: A modest but well-maintained building with oak-paneled walls and a large desk covered in papers. Mayor Thornton, a portly man with a worried expression, paces near the window. A notice board displays various village announcements.
